title: WHY AFRICAN ELEPHANTS COVER THEMSELVES IN MUD
caption: Mud baths are survival gear for African elephants. 🐘 #AfricanElephant #Wildlife #AnimalBehavior #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Why would an African bush elephant deliberately coat its body in mud?
narration_timeline.scene: Real African elephant mud-bathing clip, no artificial footage.

narration_timeline.text: On a hot day, a giant body needs ways to shed heat.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic African bush elephants in natural setting.

narration_timeline.text: At a waterhole, elephants use their trunks to spray water and splash.
narration_timeline.scene: Elephants splashing and separately drinking water, without asserting both show spraying.

narration_timeline.text: Water cools the skin, and a muddy coating can offer relief from biting insects.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual elephant bathing, explanation supported by natural behavior.

narration_timeline.text: Other elephants may join the same waterhole, turning the bath into a shared routine.
narration_timeline.scene: Multiple African elephants at real waterhole; not represented as one continuous incident.

narration_timeline.text: So this muddy giant isn't neglecting its skin. It's taking care of it.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic elephant bathing footage followed by distinct elephant group.
